referenceSources.title: ŠKODA OCTAVIA WRC - Škoda Storyboard
referenceSources.description:
A Škoda Octavia WRC rally car is presented in white and green livery, adorned with sponsor logos from Shell Helix, T-Mobile, and Michelin. The front grille carries the Škoda badge, while the hood and doors display the www.skoda-auto.com branding. The number 15 and “Rallye Monte-Carlo” decals mark its entry in the 2003 event.

Driver and co-driver names T. Gardemeister and P. Lukander appear on the side window, emphasizing the car’s racing pedigree. The aerodynamic enhancements, including a roof scoop and rally wheels, underscore its purpose-built design for high-performance rally stages.
